guide.text:
HOW IT WORKS

1. Import the mod
   R.E.A.L. Mod > Import ZIP… (or the extracted folder). The manager reads the list of supported games straight from Luke Ross' RealConfig.bat – new games in new versions are recognised automatically.

2. Find games
   The manager reads the lists of Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft, EA, Rockstar, Amazon, Heroic and Xbox plus folders like D:\Games. The result is cached, so the library is there instantly on the next start. Game missing? Games > Add game folder…

3. Prepare the game
   Start a freshly installed game once and quit it so it creates its settings files.

4. Install
   Click the game > Install. Everything the mod changes is backed up first. Then Luke Ross' RealConfig.bat runs in a console window – answer any questions there and press a key at the end.

5. Update
   Import the new ZIP. Games with an older version show "Update available". The old version is removed completely, the new one installed, your RealVR.ini is kept.

6. Uninstall
   The plan shows every change beforehand. Afterwards the manager checks for leftovers (files, registry, NVIDIA profile) and saves a report in the journal folder.
   Games installed by hand can be removed without a journal – deleted files are backed up first.

BACKUPS
 - Registry backup: only the keys the mod touches (Vulkan/OpenXR and the games' graphics settings). Compare and restore selectively.
 - Windows restore point: only as an emergency rescue right after an installation. Restored later, it undoes all changes made to the PC since then.
 - NVIDIA: Vdesync turns V-Sync off in the driver profile of the game. On uninstall only that game's entry is reset.

TIPS
 - Play the online features of games with anti-cheat (e.g. Dark Souls) offline only.
 - F5 rescans, Esc returns to the library, Ctrl+F jumps to the search.
 - Languages: just copy more language files (lang\xx.json) into the lang folder.

msg.askCovers:
Load missing game covers from the internet?

The game's name is sent to the Steam store search or to Epic; the pictures come from their servers and are stored locally. Without consent only local pictures (Steam cache) are used.

You can change this any time under Settings.
